design_philosophy.core_identity: Engineer's tool — confident, precise, data-rich. Stripe-billing-meets-Datadog.
design_philosophy.vibe: Objective, rigid, functional. No fluff, no generic purple gradients.
design_philosophy.motion: Minimalist micro-interactions for feedback. No bouncy or decorative animations.
design_philosophy.spacing_strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid. Dense, strict hierarchy, high scanability.

rules.headings: IBM Plex Sans. Use tracking-tight for sizes > 32px. Never center by default.
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans, text-sm to text-base.
rules.data_and_metrics: IBM Plex Mono is MANDATORY for all event IDs, currency amounts (₹), timestamps, API keys, and raw JSON payloads. This establishes the 'terminal/engineer' trust layer.
rules.labels: Uppercase, tiny text (text-xs), wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for table headers and overlines.

colors.rules: Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome (blacks, whites, greys). Signal colors (Red, Green, Amber, Blue) are exclusively reserved for status badges, error states, and live data indicators.

layout_and_surfaces.implementation: Expose the skeleton. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layouts (do not use default Shadcn Card for everything). Containers should have 1px solid borders. Inner grid items use `border-r border-b border-border` to create a dense, technical blueprint feel.
layout_and_surfaces.shadows: No soft diffuse shadows. Use flat design with 1px borders or hard, solid-color offset shadows if depth is strictly required.

icons.style: Regular or Duotone for dense developer tools.

buttons.primary: Solid black (`bg-[#0A0A0A]`) with white text. Sharp corners. `hover:bg-[#262626]`.
buttons.ghost: Hover state must explicitly set text color (e.g., `hover:bg-black/5 hover:text-black`).

tables.features: Sticky headers, horizontal scrolling for large event payloads, monospace data cells.

charts.styling: Monochrome bars/lines. Use signal colors only when visualizing anomalies or dropped events. No gradient fills on charts—use solid fills or technical hatching patterns.

feature_specifications.event_ingestion_console: Split view. Left: 'Terminal' themed text area (`bg-[#0A0A0A] text-gray-300 font-mono`) for pasting raw JSON. Right: Real-time response metrics (Accepted/Rejected/Duplicates) using large typography.
feature_specifications.live_event_ledger: High-density data table. Sticky leftmost column for Event ID. Use compact status badges (dot + text).
feature_specifications.meter_config_ui: Technical form layout. Left-aligned labels. Use pure HTML grids for field alignment.
feature_specifications.pricing_plan_builder: Rule-based vertical flow or side-by-side bento layout. Clear visual distinction between flat rate, volume, and tier inputs.
feature_specifications.customer_usage_dashboard: Top summary strip for MRR (₹) and totals. Recharts for usage over time. Table for included vs. billable breakdown.
feature_specifications.reconciliation_report: The most complex view. Data table with visual matching indicators. Show source vs target columns with calculated delta (variance). Highlight mismatches in Signal Red.
feature_specifications.dead_letter_queue: Focus on actionable errors. High contrast red indicators for failed HTTP codes. Bulk action footer fixed to the bottom.
feature_specifications.workspace_overview: Bento Grid ('Control Room' Mode). Tight gaps (`gap-4`). Every pixel utilized. Summary widgets (`col-span-1`), Primary Data Chart (`col-span-3`).

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based, e.g., `data-testid="submit-event-button"`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:ring-offset-1`).

brand_logo.description: Minimalist brand logo to be used in the top-left of the navigation or auth screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import `IBM Plex Sans` and `IBM Plex Mono` from Google Fonts and configure them in `tailwind.config.js`.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for complex grid layouts (Bento/Control Room grids). Do NOT rely solely on Shadcn's `<Card>` component.
Implement the 'Grid Borders' surface strategy: use `border-collapse` style layouts with `border-border` to create a dense, skeletal technical feel.
Ensure the Indian Rupee symbol (₹) and all financial/token metrics use `IBM Plex Mono`.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for headers; use solid white with a 1px bottom border.
Apply `data-testid` universally across all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows) to guarantee testability.
